description: Seed everything about a project in one call: details, the full suite tree, milestones, environments, custom fields and users — make it first when starting on a project. Each collection returns its first 100; check `coverage` and pass `full: true` to page. For one record by ID qase_get is cheaper; for filtered questions use qql_search. Cost: six API calls behind one, 0.5-1.3s cold, cached 5 minutes.

full.description: Page through every collection instead of the first 100 of each (default: false). Use it when `coverage` reports one truncated; see qase_tool_help for what it costs.

name: qase_project_context
title: Project context
